title: Connecting Tradingview and Claude Via MCP
author: tusikone
selftext:
Hey all,

I've been seeing some things on line saying its possible to connect claude and trading view via MCP. Is this true? Is it actually beneficial? I've recently had my second child and am finding it hard to continue trading whilist being a father, I've heard you can set it up to scan for your setups and get it to notify you when they appear. Can any one confirm this? Also alot of the stuff I am seeing is mac based, is it capable on windows. If anyone could point me in the right direction it would be appreciated!

Thank you in advance!

comments.author: Aayush_Gohil
comments.body:
It's correct but there is one problem, you have to continuously keep Claude polling the trading view Ambe's it just feels disconnected.

Try this out while25.com, it's AI integrated with advanced charting and inbuilt backtesting and strategy building support. It's in early stage but worth a look!

comments.author: LtLean
comments.body: I have this setup active and running on my Mac mini. I use a Claude code session to scan SPY on trading view and trade for itself and notify me of potential setups via Hermes.
